label: Contradiction-10
title: K-010: When was the release planned, and when did it ship?
description: The original embargo time has two values, 14:00 UTC (the Foundation, echoed by The Hacker News) and 11:00 ET, which is 15:00 UTC (watchTowr, echoed by CybelAngel and others). The release itself is stamped 13:34 UTC on the GitHub advisories, ahead of the announced 14:00. The ChangeLog still carries the original date. The site should say 'about 14:00 UTC, advisories at 13:34' and give both original times.
